_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits inside Disbelief with flat funding, dead ETF flows and no vol impulse; base-rate coil favors holding the rung until a clear breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial: analyst forward is explicitly HOLD/Disbelief; narrative supplies neutral-to-mildly-constructive flow color without contradicting the hold
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 50-62, funding stays near flat, and 30d momentum grinds without a spike or flush
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks above ~63 with expanding funding/ETF flows (Hope) or a VIX/funding flush drops sentiment through ~47 (Complacency)
